First, we calculate $v(t)$ by differentiating $s(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}v(t) & =\frac{\text{d}s}{\text{d}t} \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(t-2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)) \\  & =1+4\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we differentiate $v(t)$ to find $a(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}a(t) & =\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t} \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(1+4\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)) \\  & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}
$$
